comparison.objective: Mount a shaft between bench centres using a tailstock release lever; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring-loaded lever while seating two conical centre holes versus bimanual screen manipulation and orientation-dependent particle passage.
comparison.success_condition: Both points seated, lever at rest, hands clear and shaft still; candidate requires ≥98% recovered media, every washer retained and no loss.
comparison.reason: Spring-controlled shaft alignment is unrelated to granular screening despite both requiring coordinated hands.
